tagline: Global leader in materials and solutions for the semiconductor and electronics industries
hero_kpi_rationale: Net revenue is the key financial metric reflecting the company's growth and its ability to capture rising demand for semiconductors and advanced electronics, driven by AI and high-performance computing.

kpis.explanation: Sales generated by the Net segment.

kpis.name: Semiconductor Technologies Growth
kpis.description: The Semiconductor Technologies segment recorded 9% volume growth in 2025 compared to 2024.

kpis.name: Interconnect Solutions Growth
kpis.description: The Interconnect Solutions segment recorded 14% volume growth in 2025 compared to 2024

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Revenue extracted from yfinance.income_stmt over the last four years

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.explanation: Net Income — bottom-line profit after all expenses and taxes.
kpis.description: Net income extracted from yfinance.income_stmt over the last 4 years.

kpis.name: Operating Cash Flow
kpis.explanation: Operating Cash Flow — cash generated from core business operations.
kpis.description: Operating cash flow extracted from yfinance over the last four years.

kpis.name: Free Cash Flow
kpis.explanation: Free Cash Flow — operating cash flow minus capital expenditures.
kpis.description: Free Cash Flow extracted from yfinance over the last four years.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditure
kpis.explanation: Capital Expenditures — investments in property, plant and equipment.
kpis.description: Capex (Investments) extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.

kpis.name: Capital Returned (Dividends)
kpis.explanation: Capital Return — total cash returned to shareholders (dividends + buybacks).
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders via annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the last 3 reported fiscal years.
kpis.signal: Capital returned to shareholders via dividends of $0.013B in the latest year.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Payout Ratio — dividends paid divided by net income.
kpis.description: Payout ratio = Dividends paid / Net income, calculated over the last 3 fiscal years from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.
kpis.signal: Portion of net income distributed as dividends: 1.9% last year.

ai_positioning.summary: The company Q does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its annual report.

risks.title: Risk related to separation and historical structure
risks.summary: The company was recently separated from DuPont, and its historical financial statements do not reflect its future condition as a standalone entity.
risks.score_rationale: Risk is mentioned first in the risk factors and emphasizes that historical financial statements do not reflect the future situation as an independent entity. The language indicates an existential risk related to the validity of past data. Capital category heavily weighted.

risks.title: Dependence on demand for AI
risks.summary: Recent growth is heavily dependent on demand for artificial intelligence technologies, which could slow
risks.score_rationale: Multiple segments (Semiconductor, Interconnect) cite AI as the primary growth driver. A saturation or slowdown in AI demand would have a direct and significant impact. Language repeated and intensified in 2025.

risks.title: Exposition aux changes
risks.summary: Fluctuations in Asian currencies, particularly the yen and yuan, negatively affect the company's results.
risks.score_rationale: The Japanese yen, Chinese yuan, and South Korean won are cited as sources of negative impact. Although mentioned each year, the intensity of the language remains moderate. The Macro category is moderately weighted.

risks.title: Increasing investments in R&D
risks.summary: Increased investments in research and development are weighing on profitability despite sales growth.
risks.score_rationale: R&D expenses have increased every year (303M → 314M → 354M) and are cited as constraining EBITDA. This indicates profitability pressure related to innovation. Explicit language on 'growth investments' is used.

risks.title: High leverage post-spinoff
risks.summary: The separation has led to a significant increase in indebtedness, with substantial repayment obligations upcoming.
risks.score_rationale: Debt has increased from 0 to $4.0 billion by 2025. The document references contractual obligations of $4.1B in principal and $1.7B in interest. There is alarming language regarding the capital structure being 'meaningfully different'

risks.title: Concentration géographique en Asie
risks.summary: A significant part of growth depends on Asian markets, exposing the company to geopolitical and logistical risks.
risks.score_rationale: The Asia Pacific region is a key growth driver (volume +11%), but combined with currency exposure and regional geopolitical tensions, it represents an implied yet critical risk. Repeated mention of volumes in Asia.

risks.title: Pricing and product mix pressure
risks.summary: Competitive pressure leads to ongoing price declines and a downgrading of the product mix sold.
risks.score_rationale: Local pricing and product mix have declined for two consecutive years in both segments. The language is repetitive but shows no deterioration in 2025. Medium-weighted Competition category.

governance.voting_structure_note: Single class of common stock, 1 vote per share.
